name: clario
description: Clario — AI Finance Controller. Automated reconciliation, exception investigation and risk intelligence powered by a multi-agent AI architecture.

scripts.build: echo 'No build step required — static frontend served by Node.'

notes.mistral: Mistral API is called via native fetch (Node 18+). No SDK required. Set MISTRAL_API_KEY env var to enable LLM features. Without it, the system runs fully on deterministic fallbacks.
notes.vercel: This project uses a custom Node HTTP server. For Vercel deployment see vercel.json and the README deployment section.
